question:
Which of the following States has declared a social security scheme for registered newspaper hawkers in the State in 2021

considering the losses they faced during the pandemic and that they are a part of the unorganised sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The government of Odisha has announced a social security scheme specifically for registered newspaper hawkers in the state.
 
• This initiative was taken considering the financial losses that newspaper hawkers faced during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Newspaper hawkers are part of the unorganized sector, which often lacks the social security benefits available to organized workers.
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and security to newspaper hawkers to help them cope with their economic challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Social Security Schemes:**

 
 
• Social security schemes are government initiatives aimed at providing financial support and security to individuals, especially those in the unorganized sector.
 
• These schemes can include health insurance, pension plans, and financial aid during unemployment or economic hardships.
 
• Such initiatives are crucial for ensuring the well-being of workers who do not have access to formal employment benefits.
 
 
 
• **Unorganized Sector:**
 
 
• The unorganized sector refers to employment that is not regulated by the government and does not provide standard employment benefits like health insurance, retirement plans, or job security.
 
• Workers in this sector include daily wage laborers, agricultural workers, domestic workers, and small-scale vendors, among others.
 
• Due to the lack of formal employment benefits, workers in the unorganized sector are often vulnerable to economic instability.
 
 
 
• **COVID-19 Pandemic Impact:**
 
 
• The COVID-19 pandemic caused significant economic disruptions worldwide, affecting both organized and unorganized sectors.
 
• Many workers in the unorganized sector faced job losses, reduced income, and financial hardships due to lockdowns and restrictions.
 
• Governments around the world introduced various relief measures and social security schemes to support affected individuals and stabilize the economy.
 
 
 
• **Newspaper Hawkers:**
 
 
• Newspaper hawkers are individuals who distribute newspapers to households, offices, and other establishments.
 
• They play a vital role in ensuring the timely delivery of news and information to the public.
 
• Being part of the unorganized sector, newspaper hawkers often lack formal employment benefits and face economic challenges during crises like the pandemic.
